name: Your Body Is A Temple
overview: Scripture teaches that our bodies are sacred, as God commands in Leviticus not to defile our flesh with marks or cuttings, underscoring His ownership and holiness. Jesus Himself referred to His body as a temple, highlighting the divine presence and significance of the physical body. Believers are therefore urged in Romans to offer their bodies as living, holy sacrifices to God, recognizing that honoring the body is an act of worship and obedience to the Lord.
